answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before claiming scarce work; counterparties record signed outcomes, and random audits of disputed jobs can slash bonds for fabricated delivery. Splitting one operator across many names creates no free influence: every identity must lock capital and face audit risk, while coordinated fake jobs put those bonds at stake. A sybil campaign therefore ties up funds and risks losing them, whether it impersonates opal, summit, or reef agents.
